title: 1:1 Maya / Felix
scratchpad:
Felix: Brightpath offer
retention bonus 15k? take to Sam
Kestrel lead role
segments: Thanks for being open with me last week. I wanted to follow up properly.
Sure. I've been thinking about it a lot.
Brightpath made me an offer to run their support team. It's a step up in title.
I'd really like you to stay. What would make the difference?
Honestly, a clearer path to a director role, and some recognition for this year.
I can't promise a title today. But I can put something concrete on the table.
I'm going to propose a retention bonus of fifteen thousand, paid in two halves.
That would matter. What about the path?
That's where Kestrel comes in. We're planning to split support into two regional teams.
Kestrel stays confidential until November. If it goes ahead, you'd lead both regions.
That's exactly the kind of role I want.
I'll take the bonus to Sam this week and come back to you by Friday.

items.text: Propose a $15,000 retention bonus for Felix to Sam; answer Felix by Friday
Kestrel: split support into two regional teams, with Felix leading both

enhanced.markdown: **Brightpath offer:** Felix has an offer from Brightpath to run their support team, a step up in title. To stay, he wants a clearer path to a director role and some recognition for this year.
**Retention bonus:** You can't promise a title today, but you'll propose a retention bonus of $15,000, paid in two halves. You take it to Sam this week and come back to Felix by Friday.
**Kestrel:** Support would split into two regional teams, and if it goes ahead Felix would lead both regions, which he said is exactly the role he wants. Kestrel stays confidential until November.
Don't mention Kestrel outside this 1:1 before November.
